meta.volume: Pinterest 'people searched this' counts (Pinterest-rounded) read from pinterest.com/ideas search snippets (TinyFish search, include_domains=pinterest.com, location=US). Keywords without a visible count were skipped. Some counts differ slightly between snapshots (e.g. 2027 wedding trends 27k vs 24.6k, classy winter nails 41k vs 35.6k); the higher snippet value is used.
meta.method: Seed phrases per niche searched on pinterest.com/ideas; trends from logged-out trends.pinterest.com (MoM growth). Competition checked for the top 3 keywords per niche (not 5: the search tool is limited to 30 requests/min) via top-10 Pinterest results: exact = results whose title contains the exact phrase, fresh = results dated 2026 (incl. 'x days ago'), filler = Pinterest ideas pages or shopping pins. Rated Low/Medium/High by hand. Unchecked keywords have competition null.
meta.new_or_rising_legend: new = not in any earlier repo file; repeat = already in an earlier repo file; rising = Pinterest Trends growth signal. No earlier keywords-daily file existed, so this is the baseline daily run.
meta.seasonal_note: Late November: Christmas/winter terms are near peak demand and will fade after ~Dec 25; wedding and fitness (new year) terms are ramping.
